name: MrCrippy

latest.title: Grandpa's Journal
notes: A story: Grandpa Crippy's letter and six chapters that guide you through the game, each returning a page of his journal
Quest book (press L) with a tracker under the clock, plus three daily quests
Walking into any building now zooms in, like bars and libraries
Upper floors keep the same size and view, never trap you, and each floor is different
No more goal announcement spam from the locals
Fixed saving after townsfolk start using benches and stalls

message: Thanks for playing MrCrippy! New versions install right from the game.
